labels.title: Label for peripheral instance
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

init_type.description: Generate or not the PWR init code, call it or not at boot
init_type.$comment: Generate the init code of your PWR or not (enabled/disabled), call it automatically at startup or not (called/enaled)
